title: Pell counts on a circular board
summary: Tile a labeled circle with squares in two colors and dominoes in one color. Counting by domino count gives a binomial sum. Counting by whether a domino crosses the clasp gives two Pell numbers.

tasks.title: Count tilings of a straight board
tasks.role: Counts boards with a free clasp, where the circle can be cut into a line.
tasks.context: With r dominoes the linear board has n−r tiles, of which r are dominoes. The n−2r squares each come in two colors. The total counts the Pell recurrence by considering the first tile.

tasks.title: Count the clasp-crossing tilings by domino count
tasks.claim: ∀ n : ℕ, straightCountByDominoes n = claspCountByDominoes n
tasks.role: Relates the count on the remaining board to the count indexed by total dominoes, including the clasp domino.
tasks.context: Remove the clasp domino from the n+2-cell circle. If the remaining board has r dominoes, the total was r+1, and the number of squares is unchanged. Simplify the two natural-number indices in each summand.
